payload.name: Declarative Proxy StepSpec Pipeline
payload.description: Express MITM proxy request and response handling as declarative, ordered tuples of frozen StepSpec descriptors (REQUEST_PRELUDE, REQUEST_GUARDED, RESPONSE_SUCCESS, RESPONSE_FAILURE) executed via run_steps and run_guarded with explicit Outcome.CONTINUE / Outcome.HALT control flow and mode gating ('always', 'active', 'passive') in src/holon_coherence/proxy/steps/. This replaces monolithic imperative addon hooks in src/holon_coherence/proxy/addon.py with small, single-responsibility steps and explicit ErrorPolicy handling (REQUEST_POLICY, SUCCESS_POLICY, FAILURE_POLICY).
payload.action: Add or modify proxy lifecycle behavior by introducing or updating focused StepSpec functions under src/holon_coherence/proxy/steps/, registering them in REQUEST_PRELUDE, REQUEST_GUARDED, RESPONSE_SUCCESS, or RESPONSE_FAILURE in src/holon_coherence/proxy/steps/__init__.py, and verifying both unit step contracts and end-to-end addon parity in tests/proxy/test_steps.py and tests/proxy/test_addon_pipeline_parity.py.
